claim: Rewarding Doubt trains LLMs by RL with a logarithmic-scoring-rule reward to emit calibrated verbal confidence alongside factual answers, generalizing to unseen tasks.
stance_target: L1/L3: training verbal confidence with a proper scoring rule is prior art (non-code)
quoted_support: Our method optimizes a reward based on the logarithmic scoring rule, explicitly penalizing both over- and under-confidence.
